sources.title: Grok 4.20 0309 Non Reasoning
sources.evidence: Direct HTTP 200 exact model page and its public embedded model record identify grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning, 1,000,000 context, TEXT/IMAGE inputs, TEXT output, functionCalling and structuredOutputs. The Reasoning tile is disabled (opacity-25); unlike the reasoning variant, this exact payload has no reasoning capability flag. It maps the beta-0309-non-reasoning identifier and other beta aliases to this ID. An internal algorithm label is not a network architecture disclosure. Parameter re-audit: reopened the original exact endpoint on October 27 (HTTP 200); the displayed model name and aliases still link this non-reasoning endpoint to Grok 4.20, with no total or active parameter specification.

sources.title: Grok 4.20 System Card, April 7, 2026
sources.evidence: Downloaded eight-page family card. Section 1.1 states text/image input and text output; app image generation and X video analysis are tool capabilities. Section 1.2 describes pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. The card evaluates single/multi-agent deployments but does not disclose total or active parameters or neural topology. It does not separately specify the 0309 non-reasoning checkpoint. Parameter re-audit independently read the parent's freshly fetched original PDF (October 27, HTTP 200), including Section 1.2 and comparison tables. Neither the training stages nor the single/multi-agent deployment labels identify another unchanged sized base or an activated-weight count.

sources.title: Elon Musk: Grok 4.20 has 0.5T total parameters, April 9, 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh direct HTTP 200 X syndication response on October 27 identifies Elon Musk and preserves the parent question explicitly asking whether Grok 4.20 is 500B total or 500B active in a larger MoE. Musk answers 0.5T total. Canonical post: https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2042123561666855235. This establishes a nominal rounded total, not an active count or dense/MoE topology. The post names the model through its parent question, without enumerating dated API modes.

sources.title: xAI Grok 4.20 model modes
sources.evidence: Provider documentation describes Grok 4.20 as one model offered in two modes through separate API models, explicitly naming xai.grok-4.20-0309-reasoning and xai.grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning. Supports mapping the named non-reasoning variant to Grok 4.20, but supplies no independent tensor count or claim that checkpoint weights are identical. Fresh direct HTTP 200 read on October 27 confirms the two-mode table and exact dated non-reasoning identifier. Its Model Parameters section describes request settings, not neural parameter counts.

sources.title: Benchmarking API Drift in LLM-Generated Quantum Code Across Successive SDK Versions, July 5, 2026
sources.publisher: Mohammad Arif Rasyidi and Syahirul Faiz / arXiv
sources.evidence: Fresh HTTP 200 original research HTML. patch.notes: xAI dates the API launch March 10, 2026; the 0309 identifier alone does not establish a March 9 release. Nominal approximately 500B total parameters comes from Elon Musk's explicit Grok 4.20 total-size disclosure, applied to its documented non-reasoning mode. Active parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed. PDF attachments use server-side search, not a direct model modality.

summary: Preserved the twelve non-parameter assessments and refreshed both count assessments on October 27. Retain nominal 500B total from freshly reopened original founder posts and exact mode mapping; explicitly retain active_parameters_b=null/undisclosed after original system card, later xAI documents, original research comparison tables and named-lineage searches. No dense=active assumption, service-agent multiplication or unrelated Grok size transfer is used.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain parameters_b=500 verified (nominal) and active_parameters_b=null undisclosed after fresh separate review.
parameter_reaudit.total_assessment: Both founder posts and parent questions were freshly fetched and independently read. The April 9 answer unambiguously says 0.5T total for Grok 4.20; preserve 500B at its nominal precision. Exact xAI and Oracle pages freshly confirm the non-reasoning mode relationship. Later comparison omissions do not erase stronger original nominal disclosure.
parameter_reaudit.active_assessment: Separately searched active/activated specifications and later original comparison tables. The April card, later 4.5/4.6/4.7 cards and June framework disclose no Grok 4.20 active count. July quantum-api-drift Table 6 has an explicit Active Params column but marks Grok 4.20 undisclosed. May faith-guidance Table 1 lists the model without numeric size. No source establishes a numeric active convention for this endpoint.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_assessment: The exact endpoint is explicitly named Grok 4.20 (Non-Reasoning); Oracle describes reasoning and non-reasoning as the model's two modes. The April original card describes pretraining, midtraining, SFT and RL without naming an unchanged sized base. Later cards describe their own training and, for 4.6/4.7, teacher-generated trajectories; this is not unchanged-weight lineage to 4.20. No structural change was found that defeats the model-level nominal 500B assignment, and no base with supported active count was established. Single/multi-agent service deployments do not multiply unique model parameters.
parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Fresh searches returned primary documentation and later original comparison studies, plus secondary directories with blank values or unsupported larger-MoE estimates. Those estimates are not adopted. The July study is a checked negative lead only: its unspecified mode and questionable unrelated metadata do not establish an alternate total or active count.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: Agent direct reopens of exact xAI endpoint, Oracle and both X syndication responses succeeded HTTP 200. Both later original research HTML pages also succeeded HTTP 200. Parent-fetched October 27 original PDFs 27/28/29/31/32 were independently read/searched from the fresh cache; no new PDF download is claimed for this agent.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: Active parameters remain undisclosed; the supported 500B total is nominal and model-level. The original posts do not give tensor precision or enumerate dated API modes. No source establishes that every tensor is activated per token.
